name: DescribePropertyProcDetail

parameters.help_en: The name or IP address of the server
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的服务器的名称或IP地址
parameters.name: remark

parameters.help_en: The user who runs the process
parameters.help_zh: 运行进程的用户的信息
parameters.name: user

parameters.help_en: The startup parameter of the process
parameters.name: cmdline

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 设置分页查询时，每页显示的进程资产的指纹信息的数量。默认值为10，表示每页显示10条进程资产的指纹信息
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The timestamp when the process starts. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 进程启动开始的时间戳。单位为毫秒
parameters.name: proc_time_start

parameters.help_en: The timestamp when the process ends. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 进程启动结束的时间戳。单位为毫秒
parameters.name: proc_time_end

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether fuzzy search by process name is supported. If you want to use fuzzy search, set the parameter to 1. If you set the parameter to a different value or leave the parameter empty, fuzzy search is not supported
parameters.help_zh: 进程名称是否支持模糊查询。要设置支持模糊查询时，请将该参数的取值设置为1，其他值或取值为空则表示不支持模糊查询
parameters.name: extend

parameters.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the member in the resource directory.

You can call the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to query the account ID
parameters.help_zh:
资源目录成员账号主账号ID。
调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: resource_directory_account_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the NextToken method to retrieve a new page of results. If you set UseNextToken to true, the value of TotalCount is not returned. Valid values:

true: The NextToken method is used.
false: The NextToken method is not used
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用NextToken方式拉取漏洞列表数据。如果使用此参数TotalCount不再返回。取值：

true：使用NextToken方式。
false：不使用NextToken方式
parameters.name: use_next_token

parameters.help_en: The value of NextToken that is returned when the NextToken method is used. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request
parameters.help_zh:
用来标记当前开始读取的位置，置空表示从头开始。

第一次调用不用填写，会在返回结果中包含第二次调用时用的NextToken，之后每次调用返回结果中都有下一次调用时的NextToken
parameters.name: next_token

PageInfo.description_zh: 查询结果页面显示的信息

Count.description_en: The number of entries returned on the current page
Count.description_zh: 当前页面显示的进程资产的指纹信息的数量

CurrentPage.description_en: The page number of the returned page
CurrentPage.description_zh: 分页查询时，当前页的页码

NextToken.description_en: The value of NextToken that is returned when the NextToken method is used

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page. Default value: 10
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时，每页显示的进程资产的指纹信息的数量。默认值为10，表示每页显示10条进程资产的指纹信息

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询到的进程资产的指纹信息的总数量

Propertys.description_en: An array that consists of the fingerprints of the processes
Propertys.description_zh: 查询到的进程资产的指纹信息的详情列表

Cmdline.description_en: The startup parameter of the process

CreateTimestamp.description_en: The timestamp of last data collection. Unit: milliseconds
CreateTimestamp.description_zh: 最新采集数据的时间戳。单位为毫秒

EuidName.description_en: The permission that is required to run the process

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the server that is associated with the process
InstanceId.description_zh: 进程关联的服务器的实例ID

InstanceName.description_en: The name of the server that is associated with the process
InstanceName.description_zh: 进程关联的服务器的名称

InternetIp.description_en: The public IP address of the server

IntranetIp.description_en: The private IP address of the server

IsPackage.description_en:
Indicates whether the process is a package installation process. Valid values:

1: yes
0: no
IsPackage.description_zh:
是否为安装包进程。取值：

1：是
0：否

Md5.description_en: The MD5 hash value of the process file

Pname.description_en: The name of the parent process to which the process belongs
Pname.description_zh: 进程所属父进程的名称

StartTime.description_en: The time when the process starts

StartTimeDt.description_en: The timestamp when the process starts. Unit: milliseconds
StartTimeDt.description_zh: 进程启动的时间戳。单位为毫秒

User.description_en: The user who runs the process

Uuid.description_en: The UUID of the server that is associated with the process

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
